Maria H.: evening team — i need to swap out, got called into a family thing. i was primary for tonight. can someone pick up primary for the 21:00-03:00 window?
Ashwin K.: hey! i can take primary until 01:00, then can shadow handoff if someone can cover 01:00-03:00
Maria H.: thanks @Ashwin K. — appreciate it. quick note: there’s an ongoing noise in eu-west serving pool, incident page in case you need context: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/incidents/eu-west-inference-noise
oncall-bot: PAGER: HIGH latency spike in eu-west-1 for model 'redwood-v1' — 95th p50 -> 1.2s. Alert triggered by latency_slo_monitor. Incident ID: INC-2026-4123. @channel
Jonathan P.: oncall-bot pinged me earlier. i'm currently secondary until 00:30, can extend to 03:00 if needed. Maria do you want me to take over full primary after 01:00?
Maria H.: that would be ideal. @Jonathan P. — i can /handoff to you now. runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/oncall-handoff
Lee S.: +1 to @Jonathan P. on coverage. i'm available as backup. also tagging SRE Rotation Bot for schedule update
sre-rotation-bot: rotation update request received. please run `/rotation confirm @Jonathan P. primary 1769505600 1769509200` to confirm handoff window.
Ashwin K.: copying handoff checklist here:
```
- confirm incident lead
- confirm access to logs (eu-west cluster)
- transfer any active pages
- update incident timeline
- notify customers if outage >15m
```
Maria H.: running `/handoff @Jonathan P.` now
sre-rotation-bot: handoff command logged by Maria H. -> @Jonathan P. pending confirmation.
Jonathan P.: i confirm — accepting primary handoff. starting now. taking notes: checking kv-cache metrics, model queue depth, deployment version 1.2.4
oncall-bot: NOTE: auto-runbook link: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/latency-investigation — recommend prefix cache check + tail latency dashboard
Lee S.: quick tip — if KV cache miss rate high, flip to cached-variant policy `cache_pref:prefer` in runtime-config for eu-west. see ops-doc snippet:
```
runtime-config:
  cache_pref: prefer
  batching: adaptive
```
Ashwin K.: leaving a short timeline: saw ramp at 20:45 -> 20:58 stabilized -> 21:05 spike again. suspect small batcher regression after deploy. if needed i can roll backend pool back to 1.2.3
Maria H.: thanks everyone. @Jonathan P. — can you add 'handoff acknowledgment' to incident timeline and mark my outgoing note? i'll update on-call rota after i get home
Jonathan P.: ack. adding to timeline. will ping @Lee S. if we need rollbacks. taking over primary responsibilities.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-4123 assigned lead: Jonathan P. Current status: monitoring. Pages will escalate to P2 if error_rate > 5% or p95 latency > 2s.
Lee S.: noted. @sre-rotation-bot if no one else picks 01:00-03:00 i'll jump in, but can we post a quick followup message just before 00:45 to check handoff?
Maria H.: yes pls. thanks all :pray:
